# Bogotá SEO (bogotaseo.com)

> Bogotá SEO helps businesses in Bogotá and across Colombia get found on Google, Google Maps and AI assistants, show what makes them special with websites built for phones, and turn visits into customers through WhatsApp. It also builds AI agents and WhatsApp chatbots that automate repetitive work with human quality control. Primary language: Colombian Spanish (es-CO); full English mirror under /en/.

- Contact: WhatsApp +1 (720) 249-6588 (https://wa.me/17202496588), or the form at https://www.bogotaseo.com/contacto/
- Customer care in Spanish and English is led by Stephany, born in Colombia and raised in Bogotá.
- The team and technology behind it: Eye To Ad Media, headquartered in Denver, Colorado (USA), building websites, SEO and marketing since 2012; 60 Google reviews (5.0 average); A+ BBB accredited.
- Policy: no guaranteed rankings or results; free quotes and a free SEO audit; no fake reviews or testimonials.
